blocks.text: Powder coating Cambridge businesses rely on starts with a shop that is close, certified and fast. Whether you have one prototype part or a full production run, our powder coating Cambridge customers get the same careful preparation, controlled curing and documented quality checks.

Koojo is a Milton-based powder coating shop, and our process combines surface preparation, electrostatic application and oven curing under one roof. What We Coat for Cambridge Businesses

We coat steel, aluminum and other metal parts for Cambridge businesses, from small brackets to heavy frames up to 6,000 lb. Every job is cleaned, prepared, coated and cured in our oven, so the finish bonds well and lasts through daily use.

Our powder coating Cambridge work covers conveyor frames, machine guards, robotic bases, weldments, railings, gates, trailer parts and equipment housings. We apply powder with electrostatic powder coating guns, then cure it in our curing oven until it forms a hard, even layer. The result is a corrosion-resistant finish and a chip-resistant finish that hold up far better than many liquid paints.

Because we are a custom shop, you choose the colour, gloss level and texture. We offer RAL colour matching, plus matte, gloss and textured finishes for indoor and outdoor parts. If you are comparing options for metal powder coating Cambridge buyers often ask one question first: will this finish survive my environment? We help you answer it before any powder goes on, whether the job is steel powder coating, aluminum powder coating or a mixed assembly.

For repeat work, custom powder coating Cambridge customers can send photos, drawings and dimensions first. We confirm what is possible, flag concerns such as welds or hollow sections, and explain what to expect before your parts leave your dock. Clear communication up front reduces rework, protects your schedule and supports the outdoor durability your parts need.
Getting Your Parts from Cambridge to Our Milton Shop

You can drop parts at our Milton shop, about 30 minutes from Cambridge on Highway 401, or ask about pickup and delivery. Our turnaround is 48 hours, and the shop is open Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM.

The route is direct. Take Highway 401 east to Milton and follow the signs to Steeles Avenue East. Plan on roughly 30 minutes without traffic, and allow extra time during rush hour. Drop-off for powder coating Cambridge orders is simple: bring your parts during business hours, and we will confirm the job details with you on arrival.

Larger orders may suit powder coating Cambridge pickup and delivery, so your team can stay focused on production. Send us your part list, quantity and target date, and we will talk through a schedule. Packaging and shipping are part of our process, so finished parts come back protected and ready to install.

Our 48-hour turnaround applies to powder coating Cambridge projects just as it does for nearby cities. If your project is urgent, call (905) 876-7060 between 7 AM and 5 PM on a weekday, and we will explain what timing is realistic. Koojo is also a [powder coating company GTA](/) buyers can work with, so every powder coating shop Cambridge customers choose benefits from the same standards across our wider service area.
Cambridge Industries We Coat For

Cambridge has a strong manufacturing base, including automotive suppliers, machine shops, fabricators and food equipment builders, and these shops need finishes that survive heavy use. We coat parts for each of these sectors with repeatable quality.

Fabricators and welding shops in Cambridge send us weldments, frames and structural parts that need a tough, uniform coat. Machine shops value careful masking of threaded holes and precision surfaces. Cambridge manufacturers and automation builders rely on us for conveyor frames, robotic bases and machine guards that must look the same from batch to batch.

For these buyers, powder coating Cambridge projects work best with one finishing partner who delivers on time and keeps batch-to-batch consistency. Production runs are easier to plan when colour, thickness and curing are controlled, and prototype parts can follow the same process before you commit to volume. That makes powder coating Cambridge a practical choice for shops that value uptime.

Automotive suppliers send brackets, frames and small parts, while food equipment makers ask about washdown-resistant finishes. For those jobs we discuss suitable powders and your compliance needs before coating starts. To see how we support each sector, read our pages on [powder coating for machine shops](/industries/machine-shops) and [powder coating for food processing equipment](/industries/food-processing-equipment). Buyers searching for powder coating Cambridge Ontario often want proof of quality too, so we back our work with documented quality checks and certification through the Absolute Bureau of Certification.
Services Cambridge Customers Order

Three services suit most Cambridge projects: industrial powder coating, sandblasting and custom colours. Each is handled at our Milton shop, with preparation first, so the powder bonds properly and the finish lasts.

Start with [industrial powder coating](/services/industrial-powder-coating) for frames, equipment and structural steel. If parts arrive with rust or old paint, our [sandblasting services](/services/sandblasting) clean the surface before coating, and we also offer mobile sandblasting for work that cannot travel. Then choose from [custom powder coating colours](/services/custom-colors-finishes) to match your brand or specification. Before coating, we handle degreasing and masking so threaded holes and mating surfaces stay protected.

Every powder coating Cambridge project starts with a review of your drawings. We look at the metal, the geometry and the service environment, then recommend a preparation method, powder type and cure. A bracket that lives indoors needs a different approach from a gate or frame that sees rain, sun and winter road salt, and we explain our reasoning in plain language so you can approve the plan with confidence.

Whichever combination you need, you can review our full range on our [powder coating services](/services) page. A powder coating Cambridge order is handled in one place: preparation, coating, curing, inspection and packaging.

Our conveyor frame project for an automotive plant shows how we coat the frames and structures that Cambridge manufacturers use every day. We prepare the steel, apply a durable powder finish and cure it for a hard, even result.

Every project begins with the same checklist: the metal, part dimensions and weight, quantity, colour code and deadline. With those details we can plan masking, choose the right powder and confirm the cure. When a powder coating Cambridge job turns into repeat orders, we aim to keep colour and process consistent so later batches match the first.

Read the [conveyor frame case study](/projects/conveyor-frame-automotive-plant) for the part, powder and turnaround details. Projects like this reflect the powder coating Cambridge work we welcome: repeatable parts, clear specifications and firm deadlines. Share your drawings, and we will tell you how we would prepare, coat and cure your part.

Powder Coating Cambridge FAQs

blocks.q: How long does powder coating Cambridge customers order take?
blocks.a: Our turnaround is 48 hours. Large or complex orders can need more planning, so send your part details first and we will confirm timing. The shop is open Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM.

blocks.q: Is powder coating Cambridge Ontario work limited to steel?
blocks.a: No. We coat steel and aluminum, and we can discuss galvanized parts before coating because they need extra care. Tell us the metal, size and finish, and we will advise on the right approach. Our team can also suggest a finish that suits indoor or outdoor use.

blocks.q: How heavy can parts be for powder coating Cambridge shops send?
blocks.a: Our oversized oven handles parts up to 6,000 lb, so many frames and fabrications fit. Share dimensions and weight in your request, and we will confirm that your part can be coated safely. If a part is close to the limit, we will tell you before it travels.

blocks.q: Do you offer pickup and delivery for powder coating Cambridge orders?
blocks.a: Yes, we offer pickup and delivery. Tell us your location, part count and deadline, and we will confirm how it can work. You can also drop parts at our Milton shop on weekdays between 7 AM and 5 PM.

blocks.q: How do I request powder coating near Cambridge Ontario?
blocks.a: Use our [quote form](/get-a-quote) to start your request: share the part, size, quantity, finish and a photo. You can also call (905) 876-7060 or email sales@koojopowdercoating.com during business hours, and we will reply with next steps.

blocks.q: Is powder coating Cambridge work backed by certification?
blocks.a: Koojo is certified through the Absolute Bureau of Certification, and quality checks are documented. Test reports are available on request, which helps if your customer or inspector needs proof of finish quality. Ask for them when you submit your quote request so we can plan accordingly.
